title: A chemically-defined protocol for generating chondrocytes from human embryonic stem cells
protocol: Transfer 1 ml of 0.1% (vol/vol) gelatin to a 35 mm culture dish.
Incubate the gelatin-coated culture dish in a cell culture incubator at 37°C for 1 hour.
Remove one cryovial of iMEF cells from liquid nitrogen storage and place on ice.
Submerge three quarters of the cryovial in a 37°C water bath to thaw the cell suspension.
Swirl the cryovial gently to facilitate heat transfer during thawing.
Transfer the thawed iMEF cell suspension along with 4 ml of MEF medium to a sterile 15 ml polystyrene centrifuge tube.
Add 90 μl of the iMEF cell suspension to a 1.5 ml microfuge tube.
Add 10 μl of trypan blue solution to the microfuge tube and mix well by pipetting up and down.
Transfer 10 μl to each chamber of a haemocytometer and perform a viable cell count.
Calculate the volume of iMEF cell suspension required: 2.92 × 10^5 cells / viable cells/ml = X ml of MEF cell suspension.
Transfer the calculated volume to a sterile 15 ml polystyrene centrifuge tube.
Centrifuge at 720 x g for 3 minutes at room temperature.
Remove the supernatant and resuspend the cell pellet in 2 ml of MEF medium.
Take the 35 mm culture dish with gelatin from the incubator.
Remove the gelatin and add 2 ml iMEF cell suspension to the dish.
Transfer the dish to the cell culture incubator.
Twenty-four hours post-seeding, check the iMEF cells under a microscope to ensure they have adhered to the surface and formed a homogeneous culture of approximately 80-85% confluence.
Remove a vial of hESc from liquid nitrogen storage and thaw as for the iMEF cells in steps 3-5 but substitute hESc medium for MEF medium.
Centrifuge the hESc at 720 x g for 3 minutes at room temperature.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 2 ml of hESc Medium.
Remove the iMEF medium from the iMEF cell layer and add the hESc suspension to it.
Transfer the cell culture dish to the cell culture incubator.
Change the hESc medium every 2 days and check for growth under the microscope.
Passage the hESc at a ratio of 1:6 when the culture reaches 90-95% confluence.
Pre-warm a 10ml aliquot of Trypsin:EDTA and hESc medium in a 37°C water bath for 30 minutes.
Remove and discard the hESc medium from the hESc culture.
Add 1 ml of Trypsin:EDTA to the hESc culture.
Incubate at 37°C under the cell culture incubator.
Check under the microscope every 2-3 minutes for cell dissociation.
Transfer the hESc suspension to a sterile 15ml polystyrene centrifuge tube.
Centrifuge at 720 x g for 3 minutes at room temperature.
Resuspend the hESc in 12 ml of hESc medium.
Remove MEF medium from the wells of the 6 well culture dish.
Add 2 ml of the hESc cell suspension to each well.
Prepare 35mm and 6 well culture dishes by transferring 1ml of 50μg/ml fibronectin to each well and incubating for at least 16 hours at 4°C.
Remove and discard the hESc medium from 2 x wells of hESc iMEF cultures and rinse twice with DPBS.
Add 500μl of Trypsin:EDTA to each of the 2 wells and transfer to the cell culture incubator.
Check the hESc cultures every 2-3 minutes as if passaging the hESc cultures on to iMEF feeder cell layers.
Transfer the cell suspension to a sterile 15ml polystyrene centrifuge tube and centrifuge at 720 x g for 3 minutes at room temperature.
Discard the supernatant and flick the bottom of the tube to disrupt the cell pellet.
Resuspend the cells in a 2ml of hESc Feeder-Free Medium.
Remove the 50 μg/ml fibronectin from the 35 mm culture dish.
Transfer the fibronectin to a sterile 50 ml centrifuge tube.
Add 2 ml of hESc cell suspension to the well coated with fibronectin.
Check under the microscope for hESc distribution.
Return the 35 mm culture dish to the cell culture incubator.
Check the hESc cultures every 24 hours under the microscope.
Replace the hESc Feeder-Free Medium every 24-48 hours.
Remove the hESc Feeder-Free Medium from the well.
Add 500 μl of pre-warmed Trypsin:EDTA to the well.
Incubate at room temperature and rock the culture dish back and forth gently.
As soon as the hESc detach, add 2 ml of hESc Feeder-Free Medium to the well.
Draw up the hESc suspension and transfer it to a sterile 15 ml polystyrene centrifuge tube.
Add another 2 ml of hESc Feeder-Free Medium to the culture dish and rinse out the remaining cells from the well.
Pool this with the hESc suspension in the 15 ml tube.
Centrifuge the hESc suspension at 720 x g for 3 minutes at room temperature.
Discard the supernatant.
Flick the bottom of the centrifuge tube to disrupt the cell pellet.
Resuspend the hESc in 4 ml volume of hESc Feeder-Free Medium.
Transfer 2 ml each to 2 wells of a 6 well cell culture dish coated with 50 μg/ml fibronectin.
Return the 6 well cell culture dish to the cell culture incubator.
Maintain a high cell density as the hESC culture becomes established.
Plate cells at a density of approximately 0.8-1×10^5 cells/cm².
Do not passage the feeder-free hESCs too early.
Coat 1×35mm culture dish by adding 1ml of 50μg/ml fibronectin and incubating overnight at 4ºC.
Detach feeder-free hESc from the cell culture plastic using pre-warmed Trypsin:EDTA.
Centrifuge detached cells at 720 x g for 3 minutes at room temperature.
Resuspend cells to a density of 5×10^5 cells/ml in hESc Feeder-Free Medium.
Remove fibronectin solution from the well of the 35mm culture dish.
Add a 2ml volume of feeder-free hESc suspension to the well.
Return the culture dish to the cell culture incubator.
Check the hESc culture under the microscope after 24 hours.
Denote the initiation of DDP when cultures reach approximately 80% confluence as Day 1.
Prepare Day 1 medium by adding 6.25 μl of 10 μg/ml mouse recombinant Wnt3a and 12.5 μl of 10 μg/ml human recombinant Activin-A to 2.5 ml of Directed Differentiation Basal Medium.
Remove hESc Feeder-Free Medium from the culture.
Rinse the feeder-free hESc culture three times with DPBS.
Add 2.5 ml of Day 1 medium to the culture.
Return the cell culture to the incubator.

Prepare Day 2 medium by adding 6.25 μl of 10 μg/ml mouse recombinant Wnt3a, 6.25 μl of 10 μg/ml human recombinant Activin-A, and 0.5 μl of 100 μg/ml human recombinant FGF2 to 2.5 ml of Directed Differentiation Basal Medium.
Remove Day 1 medium from the cell culture.
Replace with 2.5 ml of Day 2 medium.
Return the cell culture to the incubator.

Prepare Day 3 medium by adding 6.25 μl of 10 μg/ml mouse recombinant Wnt3a, 2.5 μl of 10 μg/ml human recombinant Activin-A, 0.5 μl of 100 μg/ml human recombinant FGF2, and 10 μl of 10 μg/ml human recombinant BMP4 to 2.5 ml of Directed Differentiation Basal Medium.
Remove Day 2 medium from the cell culture.
Replace with 2.5 ml of Day 3 medium.
Return the cell culture to the incubator.
Analyse Stage 1 cultures if appropriate on Day 4.
Add 0.5 μl of 100 μg/ml human recombinant FGF2 to 2.5 ml of Directed Differentiation Basal Medium.
Add 10 μl of 10 μg/ml human recombinant BMP4 to 2.5 ml of Directed Differentiation Basal Medium.
Add 25 μl of 10 μg/ml human recombinant follistatin to 2.5 ml of Directed Differentiation Basal Medium.
Add 0.5 μl of 10 μg/ml human recombinant NT4 to 2.5 ml of Directed Differentiation Basal Medium.
Remove the Day 3 medium from the cell culture.
Replace with 2.5 ml of Day 4 medium in the cell culture.
Transfer 1 ml of 50 μg/ml fibronectin to each of 5 x wells of a 6 well culture dish.
Place the 6 well culture dish at 4°C.
Add 2 μl of 100 μg/ml human recombinant FGF2 to 10 ml of Directed Differentiation Basal Medium.
Add 40 μl of 10 μg/ml human recombinant BMP4 to the medium.
Add 100 μl of 10 μg/ml human recombinant follistatin to the medium.
Add 2 μl of 10 μg/ml human recombinant NT4 to the medium.
Remove Day 4 medium from cell culture.
Add 500 μl of pre-warmed Trypsin:EDTA to the cells.
Incubate at room temperature and gently rock the dish.
As soon as cells detach, add 2 ml of Directed Differentiation Basal Medium to the well.
Draw up the cell suspension and transfer it to a sterile 15 ml polystyrene centrifuge tube.
Add another 2 ml volume of Directed Differentiation Basal Medium to rinse out remaining cells from the well.
Pool this with the cell suspension in the centrifuge tube.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 720 x g for 3 minutes at room temperature.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend the pellet.
Flick the bottom of the centrifuge tube to disrupt the cell pellet.
Resuspend cells in 10 ml of Day 5 Medium.
Transfer 2 ml of cell suspension to each of 5 wells.
Return culture dishes to the cell culture incubator.
Add 2 μl of 100 μg/ml human recombinant FGF2 to 10 ml of Directed Differentiation Basal Medium on Day 6.
Add 40 μl of 10 μg/ml human recombinant BMP4 to the medium.
Add 100 μl of 10 μg/ml human recombinant follistatin to the medium.
Add 2 μl of 10 μg/ml human recombinant NT4 to the medium.
Remove the Day 5 medium from the 5 cell culture dishes.
Replace each dish with 2 ml of Day 6 medium.
Return the cell culture dishes to the incubator.
Add 2 μl of 100 μg/ml human recombinant FGF2, 40 μl of 10 μg/ml human recombinant BMP4, and 100 μl of 10 μg/ml human recombinant follistatin to 10 ml of Directed Differentiation Basal Medium.
Remove the Day 6 medium from the 5 cell culture dishes.
Replace each dish with 2 ml of Day 7 medium.
Return the cell culture dishes to the incubator.
Transfer 10 ml of 50 μg/ml fibronectin and 10 ml of 0.1% (vol/vol) gelatin to a sterile 50 ml polystyrene centrifuge tube.
Mix well by pipetting up and down.
Transfer 1 ml of the mixed fibronectin:gelatin solution to 20 wells in each of 6 well culture dishes.
Place the dishes at 4°C.
Add 8 μl of 100 μg/ml human recombinant FGF2, 160 μl of 10 μg/ml human recombinant BMP4, and 8 μl of 10 μg/ml human recombinant NT4 to 40 ml of Directed Differentiation Basal Medium.
Remove the Day 7 medium from the cell cultures.
Add 500 μl of pre-warmed Trypsin:EDTA to each of the 5 wells.
Incubate at room temperature, rocking the cell culture dish back and forth gently.
As soon as the cells detach, add 2 ml of Directed Differentiation Basal Medium to each cell culture dish.
Draw up the cell suspension and transfer it to a sterile 15 ml polystyrene centrifuge tube.
Add another 2 ml of Directed Differentiation Basal Medium to the culture dishes to rinse out remaining cells from the well.
Pool this with the cell suspension in the centrifuge tube.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 720 x g for 3 minutes at room temperature.
Discard the supernatant.
Flick the bottom of the centrifuge tube to disrupt the cell pellet and resuspend the cells in 40 ml of Day 8 Medium.
Remove the fibronectin:gelatin solution from the culture dishes.
Transfer 2 ml of the cell suspension to each of the 20 wells of the new culture dishes.
Return the culture dishes to the cell culture incubator.
Add 8 μl of 100 μg/ml human recombinant FGF2 to 40 ml of Directed Differentiation Basal Medium.
Add 80 μl of 10 μg/ml human recombinant BMP4 to the same medium.
Add 80 μl of 10 μg/ml human recombinant GDF5 to the mixture.
Add 8 μl of 10 μg/ml human recombinant NT4 to the final solution.
Remove the Day 8 medium from the cell cultures.
Replace with 2 ml of Day 9 medium in each well.
Return the culture dishes to the cell culture incubator.
Add 8 μl of 100 μg/ml human recombinant FGF2 to 40 ml of Directed Differentiation Basal Medium on Day 10.
Add 80 μl of 10 μg/ml human recombinant BMP4 to the medium on Day 10.
Add 80 μl of 10 μg/ml human recombinant GDF5 to the medium on Day 10.
Add 8 μl of 10 μg/ml human recombinant NT4 to the medium on Day 10.
Remove the Day 9 medium from the cell cultures.
Replace with 2 ml of the prepared Day 10 medium in each well.
Return the cell cultures to the incubator.
Add 8 μl of 100 μg/ml human recombinant FGF2 to 40 ml of Directed Differentiation Basal Medium on Day 11.
Add 160 μl of 10 μg/ml human recombinant GDF5 to the medium on Day 11.
Add 8 μl of 10 μg/ml human recombinant NT4 to the medium on Day 11.
Remove the Day 10 medium from the cell cultures.
Replace with 2 ml of the prepared Day 11 medium in each well.
Return the cell cultures to the incubator.
Transfer 1 ml of a 0.1% (vol/vol) gelatin solution to 30 wells of 6-well cell culture dishes.
Place the dishes at 4°C.
Add 12 μl of 100 μg/ml human recombinant FGF2 to 30 ml of Directed Differentiation Basal Medium.
Add 240 μl of 10 μg/ml human recombinant GDF5 to the mixture.
Add 12 μl of 10 μg/ml human recombinant NT4 to the mixture.
Remove Day 11 medium from cell cultures.
Add 500 μl of pre-warmed Trypsin:EDTA to each well.
Incubate at room temperature, gently rocking the dishes.
As soon as cells detach, add 2 ml of Directed Differentiation Basal Medium to each dish and draw up the cell suspension.
Transfer cell suspension in equal volumes to two sterile 50 ml centrifuge tubes.
Add another 2 ml volume of Directed Differentiation Basal Medium to culture dishes and rinse out remaining cells from the well.
Transfer this cell suspension in equal volumes to the two 50 ml centrifuge tubes.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 720 x g for 3 minutes at room temperature.
Discard the supernatant after centrifugation.
Flick the bottom of the centrifuge tube to disrupt the cell pellet and resuspend cells in 30 ml of Directed Differentiation Basal Medium.
Remove 0.1% (vol/vol) gelatin solution from wells.
Transfer 1 ml of the cell suspension to each of the 30 wells of a 6 well culture dish.
Add 1 ml of the 2 X Day 12 medium to each of the 30 wells.
Return the culture dishes to the cell culture incubator.
Add 12 μl of 100 μg/ml human recombinant FGF2 to 30 ml of Directed Differentiation Basal Medium.
Add 240 μl of 10 μg/ml human recombinant GDF5 to the medium.
Add 12 μl of 10 μg/ml human recombinant NT4 to the medium.
Remove Day 12 medium from cell cultures.
Replace with 1 ml each of Directed Differentiation Basal Medium in each of the 30 wells of the 6 well cell culture dishes.
Add 1 ml each of the 2 X Day 13 medium to each of the 30 wells.
Return the cell cultures to the incubator.
Terminate the cultures on Day 14.
Carry out Stage 3 (end point) analyses.
